authority_basis.claim_scope: Static friction adapts up to a limiting value; kinetic friction applies after sliding under the stated model.

concepts.statement: Static friction takes the value needed to prevent relative sliding up to its limiting value, rather than always equalling that limit.
concepts.why_required: The static-friction force is determined by the no-slip constraint until the maximum available value is reached.
concepts.failure_if_omitted: Learners may substitute mu_s N automatically even when a smaller static friction is sufficient.

model_conditions.condition: The contact is modelled by the stated Coulomb static/kinetic friction approximation.
model_conditions.physical_reason: The coefficient laws are an idealized macroscopic contact model rather than universal microscopic laws.
model_conditions.failure_consequence: Velocity, temperature or material-dependent friction may require a different constitutive model.

model_conditions.condition: The stick or slide regime is identified before selecting the friction relation.
model_conditions.physical_reason: Static and kinetic friction obey different constraints in this model.
model_conditions.failure_consequence: The wrong friction law can be applied before the static threshold is tested.

representations.semantic_geometry: A contact FBD shows normal and friction forces together with a cue for actual relative sliding or the tendency that static friction opposes.
must_not_imply: static friction always equals mu_s N
friction always opposes the object's absolute velocity rather than relative contact tendency
representations.verification_method: Determine the required static friction from dynamics, compare it with mu_s N, and only then switch to the kinetic relation if sliding occurs.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: Decide whether the contact is sticking or sliding, or solve provisionally under the no-slip constraint.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: The static maximum can be used as if it were the actual friction force.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: When sticking is possible, determine the friction actually required by the dynamics and constraint.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: The friction magnitude is guessed rather than solved from the no-slip model.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: Compare the required static friction with the limiting value before declaring sliding and using kinetic friction.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: A sticking solution may be rejected or a sliding model may be applied prematurely.

required_transformations.description: Identify the relative sliding direction or tendency that determines friction direction.
Compare required static friction with its limit before selecting the kinetic-friction model.

misconceptions.incorrect_model: Static friction is always mu_s N.
misconceptions.why_plausible: The expression mu_s N is often memorized as 'the friction formula' instead of the upper limit for static friction.
misconceptions.required_counterexample: A block resting on a horizontal table with no horizontal force has fs=0 even though mu_s N is positive.
misconceptions.required_representation_repair: Show the required-friction value on a 0-to-mu_sN interval before the threshold is reached.
misconceptions.required_technical_repair: Treat mu_s N as the maximum available static friction, not its automatic value.
misconceptions.verification: Solve the required fs from dynamics and check |fs| <= mu_s N before accepting the static regime.

problem_families.name: Static-friction threshold problems
recognition_cues: applied force below or near threshold
problem_families.first_technical_move: Solve the friction required for no slip, then compare with mu_s N.
fatal_errors: setting fs=mu_sN before testing the threshold

problem_families.name: Sliding-friction dynamics
problem_families.first_technical_move: Determine sliding direction and compute N before applying |fk|=mu_kN.
fatal_errors: using static coefficient after sliding begins
choosing friction direction from absolute motion without contact-relative reasoning

falsification_cases.authoring_defect: Replace the static-friction inequality with unconditional fs=mu_sN.
